title: Ancient Proteins Extraction Protocol
author: Ashley Scott
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7vwhn7e
materials: Prepare solutions and label all tubes that will be needed for Day 1

steps.title: Weigh samples and prepare blanks
steps.instruction: Weigh 5–10 mg of each sample into a 1.5 mL Safelock Eppendorf tube and set up empty tubes for blank extractions to be processed alongside the samples.

steps.title: Add EDTA and rotator incubation
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 0.5 M EDTA to each sample tube (including blanks), close tightly, and place on a rotator until the calculus is completely dissolved or becomes buoyant and feathery, typically 2–5 days.

steps.title: Centrifuge decalcified samples
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 14,000 rcf for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect EDTA supernatant backup
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the EDTA supernatant to a new labeled tube and store at –20 °C as a backup.

steps.title: Load filter unit with UA and supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of UA solution to a Microcon 30 kDa filter unit, then transfer the remaining ~200 µL EDTA supernatant (avoiding the pellet) into the filter unit and resuspend thoroughly.

steps.title: Spin filter (first UA wash)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter unit at 14,000 rcf, 18 °C for 15–18 minutes.

steps.title: Lyse pellet with SDS buffer
steps.instruction: To the remaining pellet, add 30 µL of SDS‑lysis buffer, resuspend, and incubate on a heat block for 5 minutes at 95 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 14,000 rcf, 18 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add UA to filter with pellet supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of UA solution to the same filter unit, then add the ~30 µL pellet supernatant (avoiding debris) and resuspend.

steps.title: Spin filter (second UA wash)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter unit at 14,000 rcf, 18 °C for 15–18 minutes until all liquid passes through.

steps.title: Add second UA wash
steps.instruction: Add another 200 µL of UA solution to the filter unit.

steps.title: Spin filter (third UA wash)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rcf, 18 °C for 15–18 minutes until all liquid passes through.

steps.title: Store remaining pellet
steps.instruction: Place the tube containing the remaining pellet at –20 °C for storage.

steps.title: Alkylate proteins with IAA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 0.05 M IAA solution to the filter unit.

steps.title: Dark mixing and incubation
steps.instruction: Mix at 300 rpm in a thermo‑mixer for 1 minute in the dark (cover with foil), then incubate for 15–20 minutes in the dark.

steps.title: Centrifuge after IAA treatment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rcf, 18 °C for 12–15 minutes until all liquid passes through.

steps.title: Three urea washes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of urea solution to the filter unit and centrifuge at 14,000 rcf for 15–18 minutes; repeat this wash a total of three times, discarding the flow‑through each time.

steps.title: Three TEAB washes
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 0.05 M TEAB to the filter unit and centrifuge at 14,000 rcf for 12–15 minutes; repeat twice more for a total of three TEAB washes.

steps.title: Add trypsin and digest
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of trypsin solution to each filter unit and incubate overnight at 37 °C in a thermo‑mixer set to 300 rpm.

steps.title: First peptide elution with TEAB
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin filter to a new labeled collection tube, add 40 µL of TEAB solution, and centrifuge at 14,000 rcf for 10 minutes, retaining the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second peptide elution with TEAB
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step once more (add 40 µL TEAB and centrifuge 14,000 rcf, 10 minutes, keep flow‑through).

steps.title: NaCl wash of filter
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 0.5 M sodium chloride solution to the filter and centrifuge at 14,000 rcf for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Acidify peptide filtrate
steps.instruction: Acidify the combined filtrate with trifluoroacetic acid to pH < 3, using approximately 18 µL TFA.

steps.title: Desalt peptides
steps.instruction: Desalt the acidified peptide solution using a method of choice (e.g., StageTips or ZipTips).
